errors.description: frame_meta_q is a multi-bit value produced in pixel_clk and sampled directly in system_clk without a bundled-data handshake or hold guarantee.
vsync_pulse_q is a one-cycle pixel_clk pulse consumed directly in system_clk, so the event can be missed or sampled metastably.
vsync_toggle_q reconverges with a one-sample system_clk history, allowing metastability or double-counting in system_event_o.
color_mode_sync_q receives independently synchronized bits from encoded control vector color_mode_q before decoding in system_clk, so transient illegal modes can be observed.
pixel_rst_n is used as data inside system_clk logic, so reset deassertion can asynchronously change destination state.
display_snapshot_q combines pixel_clk payload state with system_clk status state in display_clk without a cross-domain snapshot protocol.
